summary: Count to 20, and name, match and write the numbers 0 to 10.
Count objects to tell how many, one number each, or see small groups at a glance.
Compare groups: more than, less than or equal, up to 10.
Add by putting together or adding to, and subtract by taking apart or taking away.
Name and describe flat and solid shapes, and where things are: above, below, beside.
Compare shapes of any size or turn, build them, and put small shapes into big ones.
Describe and compare how long or heavy everyday things are.
Sort objects into groups, count each group, and say which has more or less.
